ruleDefinitions.name: AWS IAM S3Browser Templated S3 Bucket Policy Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects S3 browser utility creating Inline IAM policy containing default S3 bucket name placeholder value of "<YOUR-BUCKET-NAME>". Note: Unmapped fields: eventSource, eventName, userAgent, requestParameters

sequences.query: (eventSource = "iam\.amazonaws\.com" AND eventName = "PutUserPolicy" AND userAgent = RGX(".*S3\\ Browser.*") AND (requestParameters = RGX(".*\\"arn\\:aws\\:s3\\:\\:\\:\\<YOUR\\-BUCKET\\-NAME\\>\\/*\\.*") AND requestParameters = RGX(".*\\"s3\\:GetObject\\.*") AND requestParameters = RGX(".*\\"Allow\\.*")))
